name: Matt Danner
bio: Matthew Thomas Danner is an American director, screenwriter, animator, producer and voice actor.

credits.title: Good Night June
credits.overview: Amid endless rain, environmental chaos and a society ruled by violence, a mother must protect her daughter from the external dangers of their dystopian world and the perilous threat within their own home.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
credits.overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
credits.overview: When laidback Greg finds himself at odds with his dad's outsized expectations, pressure builds to turn his act around. After a series of hilarious near disasters, Greg's dad presents him with an ultimatum that just might challenge his wimpy ways for good.

credits.title: 1 in the Chamber
credits.overview: A work-obsessed assassin sent to “retire” her coworker is shocked to discover her target is pregnant and infuriated by how baby-proofed a nursery can be.

credits.title: Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
credits.overview: Nick Daley is following in his father's footsteps as night watchman at the American Museum of Natural History, so he knows what happens when the sun goes down. But when the maniacal ruler Kahmunrah escapes, it is up to Nick to save the museum once and for all.

credits.title: Club Penguin Halloween Panic!
credits.overview: Happy Halloween from Club Penguin! Everyone is in the spirit for Halloween treats, except for master- prankster Blizzard who feels that tricks are the treat. credits.title: Team Hot Wheels: Build the Epic Race
credits.overview: Greasebeard and his road pirates join the Epic Race and it is up to Team Hot Wheels to stop them. But, with a saboteur among them, they must find a new way to keep the pirates from winning and learn about friendship along the way.

credits.title: Club Penguin Monster Beach Party
credits.overview: It’s summer time on Club Penguin Island and resident party planner Jangrah has prepared the perfect “Surf ‘n’ Sno-cone” Beach Party for all of her penguin friends. credits.title: Team Hot Wheels: The Skills to Thrill
credits.overview: When Larry's brother Garry arrives in town selling cars that drive themselves, the citizens of Hot Wheels City are thrilled. When these cars start causing problems, it is up to Team Hot Wheels to show their skills.

credits.title: We Wish You a Merry Walrus

credits.title: Team Hot Wheels: The Origin of Awesome!
credits.overview: TEAM HOT WHEELS: ORIGIN OF AWESOME! - Gage, Wyatt, Brandon and Rhett are four kids who are about to discover that life is better in the fast lane. Ride along with Team Hot Wheels as they race to save their town! Stars George Grant & David Lodge.

credits.title: MEGA MEGA Whoosh
credits.overview: Pilot for an unproduced Disney XD series.

credits.title: Le Door
credits.overview: An inter-dimensional explorer named Le Door takes his young apprentice Frank on a tour through his old academy, only to enter a competition against his old sidekick-turned-rival Zee Window and his apprentice Zee Donut Hole.

credits.title: The Champions of Mexican Wrestling
credits.overview: Dragon Rojo Jr., Mr. Profesional, ¡Sorpresa!, Rayo X and TseTse Fly are five friends who, with their fabulous wrestling skills, try to defend in the ring a village being attacked by a group of monstrous rudos (bad guy wrestlers) under the leadership of Rey Extremo. By the creators of ¡Mucha Lucha!

credits.title: Go! Go! Moba Boy!
credits.overview: A 9 year old boy uses two alien superphones to be a superhero.
